resources.string: Your stored PIN cannot be read. Your wallets and the original PIN record are retained. Verify ownership to choose a new PIN.
Recovery could not be completed, or its authorization expired. Your retained data has not been removed. Try again.
Choose a wallet key and enter its backup. It must match the saved public identity. A matching backup can also repair that key.
No saved wallet identity can currently be verified. Use previously enabled strong biometrics, or device unlock for view-only access.
Device unlock opens balances and public addresses only. Sending, signing, and key backups remain locked until you recover the wallet PIN.
Ownership verified. Choose a new wallet PIN.
